title: Nine Circles of Hell
description:
The only escape is down through the centerThe game board is a set of concentric rings, each inner ring lower than its outer neighbor, with a set of sloping notches cut at various intervals. Your set of marbles starts in the notches of the outermost ring. When a ring is rotated, a marble will drop through any aligned notch. Drop through the center and you leave the board. Clear all your marbles from the board and you win.

• Play solo against different computer strategies.

• Multi-player against others in the Steam Community.

• Select from various game options for number of players, count of marbles, starting positions, scoring, exit constraints, ...

• Configure the board and marble appearance.

• Game play is based on a physics simulation of ramps and rolling balls.
This is a purposefully slow-paced, non-violent, turn-based game that gives you plenty to contemplate as you consider your next move.
description_short: A simple strategy game: rotate a ring, align the notches and your marbles fall towards the center. Drop all your marbles through the central hole and you win.
